segments.comment: vault.c invault() compares the guard's getlin() answer with plname by strncmpi(buf, plname, strlen(plname)) and, for a lawful hero, calls adjalign(-1) when they differ. The nethackrc name is 32 UTF-8 bytes; options.c nmcpy() keeps 31, so plname ends with the first byte of the final two-byte letter. The hero types all 32 bytes, one key per byte: strlen(plname) is 31, the first 31 bytes match, and there is no penalty, although the answer and plname differ as characters. A lawful dwarvish Valkyrie starts with alignment record 0, and explore mode keeps the name (debug mode would replace it with "wizard") while Ctrl-X still shows the record: "You are nominally aligned", where -1 would read "You have strayed". Seeds 4120001-4123000 were scanned with the port for a vault teleporter whose "ad aerarium" engraving lies in the starting room; on this seed the hero starts on it. She searches out the secret door, kicks it open, searches out the niche with the m prefix while a jackal bites, steps on the teleporter into the vault, and waits for the guard. The clock and name were chosen before the scan.
